name: ViewsTheme
install: if [ -x .cursor/scripts/cloud-install.sh ]; then .cursor/scripts/cloud-install.sh; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/share/views-theme/cloud-install.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.local/share/views-theme/cloud-install.sh"; else echo 'ViewsTheme cloud install script is not in this revision.'; fi
start: if [ -x .cursor/scripts/cloud-start.sh ]; then .cursor/scripts/cloud-start.sh; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/share/views-theme/cloud-start.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.local/share/views-theme/cloud-start.sh"; else echo 'ViewsTheme cloud start script is missing.' >&2; exit 1; fi
